purpose: Separate scheduling effects from RTC chunk-continuity guidance
replacement: aligned; drop actual elapsed prefix on arrival, retaining full H until then
latency_prediction: ceil(p95 of up to10 recent worker durations /50ms)+capture-to-request tick lag, cap49; record pre-cap estimate
warmup: 2 ordinary warmups then2 method-specific calibrated calls on held initial state; reset seed and regenerate final bootstrap before taskclock
prefix_source: actual clipped actuator history from capture tick to request tick plus known clipped future queue
normalization: checkpoint-saved ACTION normalizer; physical and model-space arrays preserved separately
ros_transport: actual two-node images and action roundtrip; actuator prefix via bounded local IPC
gpu_condition: one resident VLA; camera rendering concurrent; no other policy experiment
baseline_comparison: off vsRTC is same new H50/R30 scheduler; originalE10 or native50FIFO results are historical, not matched algorithm controls
supersedes_for_controlled_comparison: first Smol series remains provisional; no raw records overwritten or pooled

amendment.process_lifecycle: one model process per family/variant for ordered states0,1,2,3,4,5; repeated model loading between development/formal is removed
amendment.ordinary_warmup: two calls once at first state0, as implemented by existing ModelWorker.warmed
amendment.per_state_calibration: two selected-method calls on held initial state for every state including0
amendment.bootstrap_and_rng: same per-state model reset/seed and regenerated final first chunk before task clock
amendment.no_adaptive_tuning: init0 is preflight only; no hyperparameter, model, horizon or timing change may be selected from its outcomes
amendment.failure_rule: schema/transport/runtime errors stop the run; a completed but unsuccessful task is retained and does not change settings
amendment.analysis_flag: --allow-development-state0-in-summary; require config/result order0..5, retain0 separately, aggregate1..5 only
amendment.comparison_scope: compare only this new matched series; never pool the prior provisional results
